title: SB2335 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39 and Chapter 108 of the Public Acts of 2021, relative to carrying firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2022-02-01; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514162540 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/SB2335.pdf (LegiScan doc 2500675))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2022-02-01 (HB 1660 / SB 2335). Undoes the 2021 permitless-carry exception (Public Chapter 108). Effective July 1, 2022.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (g).
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): deleting the language "or who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(g)".
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1351(n)(1)): The permit holder shall have the permit in the holder's immediate possession at all times when carrying a handgun and shall display the permit on demand of a law enforcement officer.
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1366(e)): (e) The permit holder shall have the permit in the holder's immediate possession at all times when carrying a handgun and shall display the permit on demand of a law enforcement officer.
